name: dehydrogenase/reductase 4

function.text: DHRS4 is the approved symbol for dehydrogenase/reductase 4. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in 3-beta-hydroxy-5-beta-steroid dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity; 3-beta-hydroxysteroid 3-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity; alcohol metabolic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Clear cell renal cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Medulloblastoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: DHRS4 encodes dehydrogenase/reductase 4. Its functions include 3-beta-hydroxy-5-beta-steroid dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity and 3-beta-hydroxysteroid 3-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DHRS4 have been reported in medulloblastoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.
